title: Hydrants to be kept closed.
officialText: The commissioner of environmental protection shall cause all water supply hydrants within the city to be kept closed. Except in case of fire and for the purpose of extinguishing the same, or when otherwise authorized by law, it shall be unlawful to take or use the water from any such hydrant.
